concept.title: Upper, rear wipers and washer switch
concept.shortdesc: This switch has two steps to operate the upper and rear wipers and washer.

ul.li: This switch has two steps to operate the upper and rear wipers and washer.
Step 1: upper and rear wipers operate
Step 2: rear washer fluid is injected The washer function is effective while the switch is pressed, and when released, the wiper returns to the Step 1.
